events.verdict: Cardwell (SAC) makes contact with the ball and deflects it away from Mobley (CLE) prior to incidental follow-through arm contact occurring.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: DeRozan (SAC) is unable to secure the pass and the ball touches him last before going out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to the Cavaliers.
Sabonis (SAC) grasps and immediately releases Mobley's (CLE) arm off-ball, and the contact is marginal.
Sabonis (SAC) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects it away from Mobley (CLE) as the steal occurs.
Mobley (CLE) momentarily rests his hand on Sabonis' (SAC) body during the shot attempt at the basket, and the contact is marginal.
Cardwell (SAC) grabs and pulls Allen's (CLE) jersey away from his body while facing him up, which affects his ability to pursue the rebound.
Sabonis (SAC) extends his right arm and initiates contact with Allen's (CLE) body that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Tyson (CLE) is moving alongside DeRozan's (SAC) path and marginal body contact occurs on the perimeter.
Mitchell (CLE) reaches for the ball and brushes Monk's (SAC) arm at the end of the drive, and the contact is marginal.
Monk (SAC) grabs and holds Mitchell's (CLE) arm off-ball, which affects his FOM.
Tyson (CLE) grasps DeRozan's (SAC) jersey and immediately releases it as marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Allen (CLE) legally contests Westbrook's (SAC) jump shot attempt. Westbrook goes to the ground on his own after releasing the shot attempt.
Schroder (SAC) reaches in and initiates illegal contact with Mitchell's (CLE) arm as he brings the ball up the court.
Mobley (CLE) maintains a legal guarding position alongside DeRozan's (SAC) path as he defends the shot attempt.
